_doc: How a full ad (and so every recipe) looks when its maker picked none of these: the sticker's shape and fill, the headline's treatment, its entrance in the video, the number's treatment and the plates' fill. Shares are weights within each list. scripts/build_full_styles.mjs writes motion/full-styles.js from this (never edit that by hand; --check fails when it is stale); motion/fullad.js draws one of each by the seed on a stream of its own, so the colours, ground, product and words a seed drew do not move; a pick made by hand is kept. 'where': dark = only on a dark ground (glow's halo, and the highlighter, whose bar on a light pair with a dark accent would be a third colour); plain = only on the house's own gradients (GROUNDS: radial, tonal, linear), never on a photograph or a drawn scene: the underlined number has no plate behind it, and there the look draws a plated number instead (the roadmap, 2026-11-18). 'scrim': the shade the engine lays round the words (engine _scrim), held at the house's 0.3 where the treatment's own (0.65) would darken a photograph out to the frame's edge (the pre-flight's edge check failed gold and cars on their photographs, 2026-11-18); a treatment picked by hand keeps the engine's own. Every option is drawn in every pair and size by scripts/full_style_check.mjs, and kept only where the delivered picture passes the pre-flight (fullPreflight). The owner, 2026-11-18: "notice how it's all same spiky circle?", "and there's no variety in the text pure outlines?", "Also don't see any gradients really?".
